id: title:Gilbert09:clarify mcc customer not accessible error

review.posthog_relevance: Clarifies warehouse account linkage error messages for Google Ads, aiding warehouse users and support diagnostics.
review.reason: The change replaces an error message with clearer guidance distinguishing customer and manager account linkage, and updates corresponding tests. This is a localized maintenance and documentation improvement.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on the frequency and severity of this specific access-denial scenario, which is not demonstrated by the code alone.
